protocol.name: memory_rate_continuation_v1

arms.M: Full measured memory, original future targets
arms.F: Identical full measured memory plus bounded future translation from committed boundary

policy.speed: max(original plan maximum RGB step, measured incoming native-interval speed)
policy.acceleration: speed ceiling / native camera interval (SANA 8 RGB, Lyra 4 RGB)
policy.recovery: spread residual over remaining chunk duration
policy.direction: nonnegative projection along planned chunk net direction; require forward-monotone native target intervals; abstain if bounded transition cannot meet it
policy.lag: retain and report endpoint residual; no retiming or repeated residual addition
policy.units: supported native geometry mapping required; no response gain fit

qualification.sana: Released metric-sidecar training contract; frame0 reference depth supplies estimated metric conversion; processed crop/K/depth consistent. Runtime receipt required.
qualification.lyra: Initial native depth after optional MoGe alignment matched to reference depth at resized anchor pixels; apply common factor once to cameras and observer depth. Runtime depth fit required.

protocol.scope: Selected development scene and short one-boundary matched pairs, not generalization or closed-loop stability proof. No native-baseline arm; compares F directly to fresh M. Model/output velocity is not guaranteed by camera-command constraints.
controls: Exact future rotation preservation in controller and native Lyra w2c
Fresh initial calibration per case, shared only within paired arms
Initial-camera-only calibration; no target-trajectory motion fit or probe generation
protocol.resources: Serial shared GPU locks; 4 GiB launch / 2 GiB runtime disk reserve; 2 GiB available host RAM; 5400-second job timeout
protocol.other_models: LingBot/DreamX unqualified native translation mappings; Astronex/WorldPlay likewise. MatrixGame retains causal block-decoding seam; WorldWarp continuation geometry qualification pending. No broad queue resumed.

checks: Actual SANA encoder preserves prefix and encodes new future absolute poses
Actual Lyra loader applies units and resized K once

visual_review.reference: Recording RGB at the same target frame IDs; different native preprocessing and observer-derived dense pose labels limit physical ground-truth claims.

M.notes: Showroom, table, chairs and display wall remain recognizable. Small geometric and texture changes persist. No sampled patchwork failure like the earlier LingBot cases.

F.notes: Showroom structure remains recognizable. Appearance differs modestly from M in the continuation. No sampled severe collapse or newly obvious boundary break.

visual_review.trajectory_review: VIPE shows sustained backward projected motion for M. F remains near its overshot boundary position and has a later backward drift; it does not prove reversal-free generated motion. F has worse average position and rotation error against the fixed target.
visual_review.limits: Sampled RGB review is not full-video optical-flow verification or an automated scene-loss gate. Direction claims here come from the separately plotted observer estimates.

visual_review.reference: Recording RGB at matching target frame IDs; preprocessing differs and dense pose labels are observer-derived.

M.notes: Recognizable showroom, furniture and display wall throughout sampled frames. Small geometry and texture changes remain; no sampled patchwork collapse.

F.notes: Recognizable scene with a somewhat different continuation view and minor texture changes. No sampled severe collapse or clear new boundary failure.

visual_review.trajectory_review: VIPE estimates an initial backward interval for M followed by forward motion. F is forward at all sampled native intervals, but stays farther beyond the fixed target and has higher average position and rotation error. A positive net displacement alone would hide M's initial backward interval.
visual_review.limits: These RGB samples do not establish continuous temporal smoothness. Direction and tracking statements use the separately plotted pose estimates; post-hoc DA3 checks are recorded separately.
